content.content: # PHP Rules - Framework: custom MVC (PHP 7.4) — no Laravel/Symfony conventions - Namespaces: `Core\`, `Database\`, `Http\`, `Routing\`, `View\`, `Menu\` - Classes: PascalCase / Methods & variables: camelCase / Constants: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE - DB tables use `nb_` prefix (e.g. `nb_siteinfo`, `nb_admin`) - DB schema changes must go through migration files (`make m`), never alter tables directly ## Patterns ```php // Routing $router->get('/', function () { return render('pages.index'); })->name('home'); // View rendering render('pages.index'); // views/pages/index.php render('pages.works.view', ['no' => $no]); // views/pages/works/view.php ``` ## Image Upload & WEBP Optimization All Admin image uploads flow through `imageUpload()` in `inc/lib/func.php`. After saving, it automatically calls `\Core\ImageProcessor::makeWebpSibling()`. ```php // Standard upload call — WEBP sibling is created automatically $result = imageUpload($UPLOAD_DIR_CLIENTS, $_FILES['thumb_image']); $saved = $result['saved']; // e.g. "6830abc.png" — DB stores this, foo.webp created alongside // If you add a NEW upload path that bypasses imageUpload(), call manually: move_uploaded_file($tmp, "$dir/$filename"); \Core\ImageProcessor::makeWebpSibling("$dir/$filename"); // Deletion — imageDelete() handles sibling cleanup automatically imageDelete("$UPLOAD_DIR_CLIENTS/$saved"); // removes .png + .webp ``` Rules: - Do not add image resize/convert logic outside `Core\ImageProcessor`. - `makeWebpSibling()` is silent on failure — never throw from it. - Convertible: `jpg`, `jpeg`, `png`, `gif`. Skipped: `svg`, `ico`. - Max width: 2560px (auto-resize). Quality: 82. ## Image Rendering 모든 업로드 이미지 출력은 `render_uploaded_image()` (`config/functions.php`) 경유 필수. 업로드 경로에 `` 단독 태그 직접 사용 금지. ```php // 히어로 (above-the-fold — LCP) // 그리드/목록 (below-the-fold) ``` Rules: - 첫 번째 인자는 **raw 미이스케이프** URL. 헬퍼가 내부에서 escape 처리. - `$thumbnailImage = e(...)` 로 이미 escape된 변수를 넘기면 이중 escape 발생 — raw 소스 배열에서 꺼낼 것. - SVG/ICO는 `` 없이 plain `` 출력. - `class`는 `` 요소에 적용. `` 자체에 class가 필요하면 외부에서 감싸기. - 기존 파일 backfill: `php scripts/backfill-webp.php`

## **brand/proof-system.md**

```
# Proof System

Proof turns brand claims into reasons to trust NINEONELABS. Do not say we are different; show what makes the work different.

## Proof Formula

```text
Claim -> Evidence -> Client Result
```

Example:

```text
We build immersive web experiences -> Three.js runs inside the production site -> Users remember the brand through interaction, not a static page.
```

## Proof Types

### Shipped Work

Use for portfolio, case study, and services proof.

- live site
- campaign page
- app flow
- brand system
- CMS structure
- launched interaction

### Technical Capability

Use in `why` or proposal copy.

- Three.js
- GSAP
- TypeScript
- custom MVC / backend ownership
- CMS / Webflow
- performance and SEO structure

### Interaction / System Quality

Use when explaining why the experience feels different.

- scroll-triggered motion
- user flow
- reusable components
- design system
- responsive behavior
- structured content

### Operational Continuity

Use for Orbit and Maintenance.

- bug fixes
- CMS updates
- performance audits
- stability checks
- iteration cycles

### Measurable Outcome

Use only when there is a real or defensible measurement.

- faster load
- improved conversion path
- reduced support friction
- easier content updates
- stronger search visibility

## Skill Label Rule

Skill labels in `why` are proof signals. They should be short and scannable.

Good:

- `THREE.JS / INTERACTIVE WEB`
- `GSAP / MOTION & ANIMATION`
- `CMS SYSTEM / CONTENT CONTROL`

Weak:

- `We use Three.js to make cool websites`
- `Latest animation technology`
- `Best SEO solution`

## Proof Writing Rules

- Never list a tool without showing why it matters.
- Never use proof language for decoration.
- If proof becomes a service description, move it to `services.md`.
- If proof cannot be connected to a client result, remove or rewrite it.

## Korean Proof Direction

Use grounded language:

- 화면 안에서 직접 작동합니다.
- 출시 이후에도 관리할 수 있는 구조입니다.
- 사용자가 다음 행동으로 이동할 수 있게 설계합니다.
- 브랜드가 선택받는 이유를 화면에서 증명합니다.

Avoid:

- 최신 기술을 활용합니다.
- 최고의 퍼포먼스를 제공합니다.
- 차별화된 결과를 보장합니다.
```

# Positioning

Use this file when writing why NINEONELABS should be chosen over another option.

## Core Position

NINEONELABS is for brands that need a digital experience built around identity, interaction, and proof. We are not the cheapest production option and not a slow corporate agency. We are the crew that walks the brand's journey beside the client and turns undefined brand ambition into a working web/app/brand system.

## Versus Cheaper Freelancer

### What They Offer

- lower cost
- fast production
- narrower execution

### Where They Fail

- strategy, brand, UI/UX, and engineering often split apart
- long-term operation may be unsupported
- identity can become template-like

### NINEONELABS Position

We connect brand direction, screen structure, motion, implementation, and post-launch operation in one journey.

### Copy Angle

Choose NINEONELABS when the site must explain the brand, not just exist online.

### What Not To Say

- freelancers are cheap and bad
- we are premium because we cost more

## Versus Larger Agency

### What They Offer

- scale
- process
- broad teams

### Where They Fail

- slow decisions
- layers between strategy and execution
- interaction details can become handoff artifacts

### NINEONELABS Position

We keep strategy, design, interaction, and build close enough for the work to stay sharp.

### Copy Angle

The people who define the journey also shape the screen.

### What Not To Say

- large agencies are careless
- we do everything faster

### What They Offer

- speed
- low friction
- manageable content

### Where They Fail

- brand distinction is limited
- interaction is often generic
- structure follows the template, not the brand

### NINEONELABS Position

We use tools when they serve the brand, but the brand never bends to the template. The route belongs to the brand; the tools follow.

### Copy Angle

Default is safe. Uncharted is where brands begin. 템플릿이 아닌, 브랜드의 여정을 함께 그립니다.

- templates are useless

- visuals
- identity exploration
- presentation polish

- digital behavior may be underdefined
- web performance and implementation can be secondary
- design may not survive production

### NINEONELABS Position

We design identity as a working digital system: screens, interaction, content, and operation. After launch, we stay in orbit — keeping the system stable through ongoing maintenance.

### Copy Angle

Not decoration. A brand system that works on the web. 디자인을 넘기고 끝나지 않고, 운영 궤도까지 함께 갑니다.

- design studios only decorate
- engineering matters more than design

- Do not insult competitors.
- Compare through client risk, not ego.
- Always return to the concrete digital outcome.
